references.text: Psalm 127:3 describes children as a gift from the Lord, emphasizing their value in God's eyes, similar to Jesus' message in Matthew 19:14 about letting the little children come to him.

In Matthew 18:3-6, Jesus speaks of the importance of becoming like children to enter the kingdom of heaven, which resonates with his call in Matthew 19:14 not to hinder the little children from coming to him.
Luke 18:16-17 contains a parallel event where Jesus also emphasizes that the kingdom of heaven belongs to those who are like children, directly related to the event in Matthew 19:14.
Mark 10:14-16 gives a parallel account where Jesus urges the disciples to let the little children come to him and blesses them, reflecting both the event and the message of Matthew 19:14.
